title: Accounts Receivable
description:
An industry-leading, multi-brand powerhouse is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to join their central finance team. Operating at an impressive scale across a diverse portfolio of consumer-facing brands, this fast-paced group is entering another thrilling phase of growth. For an ambitious senior professional who is eager to optimise processes and make an impact, this is an ideal time to join a highly respected business. In this assignment, the successful candidate will take ownership of complex sales ledgers, lead month-end closing procedures, handle high-level client queries, and drive cash visibility.

What we are looking for:
- Previous experience working in a fast-paced environment and managing complex, high-volume corporate ledgers, ideally within retail, FMCG, or hospitality.
- Confident verbal and written communication to resolve disputes, manage corporate relationships, and liaise with cross-functional stakeholders up to director level.
- Exceptional organisation and time management to drive monthly deadlines and maintain robust financial controls across multiple business units.
- Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and strong proficiency with large-scale ERP or finance platforms.

What you will receive:
- An immediate start assignment that can offer a genuine pathway to a permanent role and long-term career in a market leader business that fast-tracks progression and internal development.
- The chance to collaborate with a supportive, welcoming, and high-achieving central finance team in a progressive, vibrant, and rewarding corporate culture.
- Access to an industry-leading employee rewards platform, featuring substantial lifestyle and dining discounts across a premier brand portfolio, comprehensive private health perks, and robust wellness schemes.
- An enviable work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and a modern hybrid model, split between working from home and collaborating in a state-of-the-art office.

If you are a driven and highly knowledgeable Accounts Receivable professional and you are ready to take the next step in your career, please do not hesitate and reach out today!

title: Billing & Accounts Receivable Assistant
description:
- Billing & Accounts Receivable Assistant
- 6 Month Contract, chance to go permanent
- £32k, hybrid, immediate start

Billing & Accounts Receivable Assistant
This is a brilliant opportunity to join a business that is growing at a seriously impressive pace, based right in the heart of Birmingham city centre. You'll take ownership of billing and the wider accounts receivable process, playing a key part in making sure the money coming into the business keeps up with its growth. It starts as a 6 month fixed term contract, but with the business expanding as quickly as it is, there's every chance this becomes permanent for the right person.
You'll be someone with solid accounts receivable or billing experience who gets real satisfaction from sending invoices out accurately and on time. You're comfortable in a fast-moving environment, you like having plenty to get your teeth into, and you don't need your hand held to get things done. Most importantly, you're available immediately and ready to hit the ground running.

What You Will Be Doing
- Taking ownership of the billing process from start to finish, raising accurate invoices so customers are billed correctly and on time.
- Working through a high volume of invoicing each day, making sure every invoice is backed up by the right supporting information.
- Allocating incoming cash to customer accounts promptly and accurately, so the ledger always gives a true picture.
- Investigating unallocated or unidentified payments and doing the detective work to get them where they belong.
- Raising credit notes and handling billing queries, working with colleagues across the business to get to the bottom of any discrepancies.
- Keeping the sales ledger clean and up to date, the kind of ledger you'd be proud to hand to anyone.
- Carrying out regular account reconciliations and spotting anything that doesn't look right before it becomes a problem.
- Acting as a helpful, professional point of contact for customer account queries by phone and email.
- Using Excel every day to manage data, pull reports and stay on top of your workload.
- Supporting month end and pitching in on wider finance projects as the business continues to grow.

What We Need From You
- Previous experience in an accounts receivable, billing or sales ledger role, so you already know your way around the process.
- Someone who takes real pride in accuracy. This role involves a lot of invoicing, and getting it right first time really matters.
- Confidence using Excel day to day, including things like filters, lookups and working with larger sets of data.
- Hands-on experience with cash allocation and reconciling customer accounts.
- Someone who thrives when things are busy and can prioritise a growing workload without losing their cool.
- A proactive problem solver who enjoys chasing down the answer rather than leaving a query sitting in the inbox.
- Great communication skills, as you'll be speaking with customers and colleagues regularly.
- Immediate availability or a very short notice period, ready to start as soon as possible.

What's in it for you
- A salary of £32,000.
- Hybrid working, giving you a great balance between the office and home.
- Genuine potential for the role to go permanent as the business continues its rapid growth.
- A city centre base with excellent transport links.
- The chance to join a business at an exciting stage, where your work has a real, visible impact.

If this sounds like your kind of role and you're ready to start straight away, apply today and we'll be in touch.

title: Credit Control
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join a busy finance team based in Birmingham. This is a key role within the business, responsible for managing the full credit control function and ensuring the timely collection of outstanding debt across a varied ledger.

You will be a confident communicator who is comfortable building relationships with clients while maintaining firm control over outstanding balances. You will bring a methodical approach to your work, a strong eye for detail, and the ability to manage a high-volume workload without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Please note: This role is exclusively recruited for via Consula. Applications made outside of Consula will not be considered and cannot progress. To apply, you must submit your application through the Consula platform

Key Responsibilities

Manage a busy ledger, proactively chasing outstanding invoices by telephone, email, and letter in line with agreed credit terms.

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, resolving payment queries and disputes efficiently and professionally.

Monitor debtor accounts and escalate overdue balances in line with company policy.

Allocate cash receipts accurately and reconcile accounts on a regular basis.

Prepare aged debtor reports and present updates to the finance team and senior management.

Liaise with internal teams including sales, operations, and customer service to resolve billing queries and disputes.

Assess the creditworthiness of new and existing customers, recommending credit limits where appropriate.

Support the wider finance team with month-end processes and reporting as required.

What We Are Looking For

Proven experience in a Credit Control role, with a track record of successfully reducing debtor days and managing a high-volume ledger.

Strong communication skills - you are confident on the telephone and in writing, and can handle difficult conversations professionally and calmly.

Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise a busy workload and meet deadlines consistently.

Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.

A team player who is also capable of working independently and using their own initiative.

What's On Offer

Hybrid working with flexibility built in.

A stable, permanent role within a well-established business.

Supportive finance team with real opportunities to develop your career.

Competitive benefits package including pension and holiday allowance.

This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.

title: Credit Controller
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Credit Controller to join a successful and growing organisation based in Birmingham City Centre. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build their career within Credit Control and gain valuable experience within a professional and supportive finance team.

Working alongside experienced members of the finance function, you'll play an important role in helping to manage the company's outstanding debt and maintain strong relationships with customers. You'll be responsible for contacting customers regarding overdue payments, allocating cash, resolving account queries and keeping accurate records of collection activity. You'll also have the opportunity to gain exposure to aged debt reporting, account reconciliations and wider credit control processes as your confidence develops.

This role would suit someone who has some previous experience within Credit Control, Accounts Receivable, Finance Administration or a similar finance environment, but is keen to take the next step. You don't need to be an experienced Credit Controller. The business is looking for someone who is confident communicating with customers, comfortable working with figures and genuinely motivated to learn and develop.

Skills Required
- Some previous experience within Credit Control, Accounts Receivable, Finance Administration or a similar role would be beneficial, although candidates with transferable experience will also be considered.
- Confident communication skills, with the ability to speak professionally with customers and build positive relationships while remaining comfortable discussing outstanding payments.
- A proactive and positive approach to work, with the motivation to follow up outstanding invoices and ensure queries are progressed through to resolution.
- Good numerical and organisational skills, with a strong attention to detail when maintaining customer accounts and financial records.
- The ability to manage your own workload effectively, prioritising tasks and following established processes to ensure debts are collected within agreed timescales.

What You Will Receive
- Full training and support, you'll be joining an experienced team who will provide guidance and mentoring while you develop your understanding of credit control and wider finance processes.
- A supportive team environment, working alongside experienced finance professionals in a collaborative environment where you'll be encouraged to learn, ask questions and develop your confidence.
- Work in a professional company that is committed to helping employees develop their skills and progress within the business, making this an excellent role for someone building a long-term career.
- Hybrid working, offering flexibility alongside the opportunity to work collaboratively with the wider finance team.
- Excellent exposure to the wider business, giving you the opportunity to work with colleagues across different departments and understand how Credit Control contributes to the overall success of the organisation.

Summary

This is a fantastic opportunity for a Junior Credit Controller, Accounts Receivable Assistant or Finance Assistant looking to take the next step in their career. If you're confident speaking with customers, comfortable working with numbers and keen to develop your finance knowledge, this role offers the training, support and progression needed to build a successful long-term career within Credit Control

title: Finance Assistant
description:
- Finance Assistant
- Permanent, full time
- Up to £28k, hybrid, study support

Finance Assistant
This is a brilliant opportunity for someone early in their finance career who wants to build a genuinely well-rounded skill set. Rather than being boxed into one ledger, you'll get hands-on experience across both accounts payable and accounts receivable, giving you a real understanding of how a finance function works. With a salary of up to £28,000, on-site training, study support and hybrid working from a Birmingham city centre office, this role is built to help you grow.
We're looking for someone with around 12 to 18 months of finance experience who already knows their way around invoices, payments and reconciliations. You don't need to have it all figured out, but you'll be comfortable with the basics and hungry to learn the rest. If you're the kind of person who wants to understand the "why" behind the numbers, not just process them, you'll fit right in.

What You Will Be Doing
- Taking ownership of processing supplier invoices from start to finish, making sure each one is matched, coded correctly and backed up by the right paperwork.
- Preparing and supporting weekly payment runs so suppliers are paid accurately and on time.
- Reconciling supplier statements and getting to the bottom of any discrepancies before they turn into bigger problems.
- Raising sales invoices and credit notes, keeping the sales ledger accurate and up to date.
- Allocating customer receipts and keeping a close eye on the cash coming into the business.
- Chasing outstanding payments in a friendly but firm way, building strong customer relationships along the way.
- Handling supplier and customer queries by phone and email, becoming the helpful, knowledgeable contact people actually want to deal with.
- Using Excel every day to track, reconcile and report, building your confidence with lookups and pivot tables as you go.
- Supporting the wider team with month-end tasks, giving you early exposure to how the bigger picture comes together.
- Learning from an experienced finance team through structured on-site training, with more responsibility coming your way as your skills grow.

What We Need From You
- Around 12 to 18 months' experience in a finance or accounts role, whether that's purchase ledger, sales ledger or a bit of both.
- Someone who takes real pride in their work. You'll be handling a high volume of invoices and payments, so accuracy really matters and we need someone diligent who naturally double checks their work.
- A confident Excel user who's comfortable working in spreadsheets every day and keen to sharpen those skills even further.
- Someone who genuinely loves to learn and sees training as an opportunity rather than a box to tick.
- A clear, friendly communicator who's happy picking up the phone to chase a payment or sort out a query.
- Someone organised enough to juggle deadlines across both payables and receivables without dropping the ball.
- Ambition to build a long-term career in finance, whether you're already studying towards a qualification or thinking about starting one.
- Available immediately or on a short notice period, as we're keen to get the right person started as soon as possible.

What's in it for you
- A salary of up to £28,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working, giving you a healthy balance between the office and working from home.
- Study support to help you work towards a professional finance qualification.
- Structured on-site training from a team who genuinely want to see you succeed.
- A city centre office with excellent train, tram and bus links.
- Real progression, with the chance to build experience across the full finance function rather than just one corner of it.

If this sounds like the step up you've been looking for, apply today and let's get the conversation started.

title: HR and Payroll Assistant
description:
HR and Payroll Assistant

Location: Birmingham, B18 5 AY
Salary: Up to £28,000 per annum, DOE + Excellent Benefits!
Contract: Full time, Permanent
Hours: 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday) 09.00 - 17.30
Benefits: 24 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays, Workplace Pension Scheme, Life Insurance, Employee Reward Card, Training and development opportunities and Opportunity to develop your HR and payroll experience within a growing operational business!

Cleone Foods Ltd is a leading UK food manufacturer, specialising in high-quality Jamaican patties and frozen Caribbean food products under our flagship Island Delight brand.

With over 30 years of heritage, we have built a strong reputation for producing authentic, flavourful, and innovative food products enjoyed by customers nationwide.

Our team-driven culture values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. At Cleone Foods, we combine traditional recipes with modern production techniques, ensuring every product meets rigorous quality standards.

Our people are central to the success of our business, and we are looking for an organised, proactive and confidential HR and Payroll Assistant to join our team.

You will report directly to the HR Manager, providing day-to-day HR and payroll support across the employee lifecycle. This is a varied, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced operational environment and want to continue developing their HR career.

As our HR and Payroll Assistant you will be responsible for:
- Support the delivery of weekly payroll, ensuring employee hours, overtime, absences, statutory payments and payroll adjustments are processed accurately and on time using Sage 50 Payroll.
- Monitor and maintain time and attendance records, investigating discrepancies and resolving payroll-related queries.
- Maintain accurate, confidential employee and payroll records, liaising with internal departments as required.
- Support the end-to-end recruitment process, including advertising vacancies, coordinating applications, arranging interviews, conducting pre-employment checks, and preparing offer and onboarding documentation.
- Coordinate new starter onboarding activities and support employee inductions to ensure a positive introduction to the business.
- Provide administrative support across employee relations activities, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence management and investigation processes.
- Arrange meetings, prepare documentation, take confidential meeting notes, and maintain accurate employee relations records.
- Support attendance management processes, including sickness absence monitoring and Return-to-Work administration.
- Provide first-line guidance to managers on established HR procedures, escalating more complex matters where appropriate.
- Coordinate employee training and development activities, working closely with managers and external training providers.
- Maintain training records and the company training matrix, monitoring training requirements and certification expiry dates.
- Assist with employee engagement initiatives, HR projects, and general HR administration to support the wider business.

In order to be successful in this role it's essential that you have:
- Previous experience in an HR administration, HR Assistant or HR/Payroll support role.
- Experience supporting payroll administration.
- Experience using Sage 50 Payroll, or strong experience with a comparable payroll system.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or above, or currently working towards a recognised HR qualification.
- Good understanding of fundamental UK employment law and HR procedures.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to prioritise competing workloads and meet deadlines.
- Professional and approachable manner.
- Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information appropriately.
- Ability to build effective working relationships with employees, Team Leaders and Managers.

It would be great if you had:
- Previous experience within food manufacturing, FMCG or another fast-paced operational environment.
- Experience supporting weekly payroll.
- Experience using HR information and time-and-attendance systems.
- Experience providing administrative support for disciplinary, grievance and absence-management cases.
- Knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements.

If you feel you have the necessary skills and experience to be successful in this role, click on "APPLY" today!

No agencies please.

Purchase Ledger Clerk
Birmingham - Temporary

About the role
Trinity House Group are recruiting for an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk or Accounts Payable Assistant, to join a well established organisation based in Birmingham, on a temporary basis. The organisation is part way through a company wide systems transformation, and this purchase ledger role has been created to provide dedicated accounts payable support while the finance team works through the additional volume this has created. It is a hands-on, transactional finance role with genuine variety and the chance to make a real impact, working closely with colleagues across finance and operations rather than sitting behind a desk processing invoices in isolation.

- Resolve purchase ledger and accounts payable invoice queries, primarily linked to two key contractors within the organisation's repairs and assets function.

- Comfortable liaising with non finance colleagues and external contractors.
- Able to work office based Monday to Thursday in Castle Vale, Birmingham, with home working available on Fridays.

Why apply
- A genuine opportunity for this temporary purchase ledger assignment to develop into a longer term or permanent position.
